title: THE PIT AND PENDULUM: THE SLOW GENOCIDE OF THE UNDESIRED

sense.text:
The Bible describes a people. When you read the description in the Bible, you look out here and find the people that match what you are reading, and it damn sure ain’t them so-called Jews. It’s you, it’s me, it’s us.

“And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts.” The Lord got mad because we disobeyed his laws and his commandments. In the verses before, he said he would keep knocking our numbers down for our disobedience; the ones of us left alive from that judgment get a faintness sent into the heart. That is the shaken leaf.

That faintness was seen in Jackson, Mississippi, a city that is 82% our people, where the sister Tasia Fortune was found hanging behind a house in the middle of a neighborhood. The prophets marched through that neighborhood and maybe six people came out of their houses. The rest peeked through the blinds. That is a terrorized people: the oppression has beaten them into submission, and the daily cycle is go to work, go home and mind your business. Captain Galiah said the people are dilapidated, and he went beyond the buildings: their spirits are dilapidated. Everything boarded up and busted out except a modern football field, because the slaves running the ball make big money. The people feel boarded up and busted out. You can look into the windows of their soul and feel the oppression in their spirit.

A mother pulled up and said, y’all scaring my daughter, there’s so many of y’all, y’all look like me, y’all look like my son, y’all look like my father. She put the car in reverse: they coming, let me get out of here. She was not threatened by us. She was afraid of the retribution the white society would bring against her and against the brothers. We used to say it in camp as a joke, the white man ain’t looking, but it is not a joke. That is the psyche, that is the terror.

So our people put up the face that says I’m tough, I got it, while behind the mask is a scared brother and a scared sister. They are on TikTok and Facebook all day, but if it has anything to do with liberation it is, don’t show my face, because the man with the pendulum, the one that dug the pit, is going to come after me. Our enemies use terror to keep us in our place.

There must be a relief from God, and that is the way out: organize and unite up underneath Christ’s commandments. The Lord is allowing the terror to force us to come together. That is why Deacon Malachi used to say, Trump is my man, bring him on. People thought he was crazy, but he had it 100% on point: that tirade and rampage will force black folk, Hispanic folk, the twelve tribes of Israel, to come together. The Lord of Hosts is mustering it up.

precepts.why:
Our people are afraid when someone comes to seek their welfare, because they know the grief the enemies will levy upon them for it. “When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.”

Exceedingly: they got very angry. That is how our enemies feel when we go into these areas and lift our brothers and sisters up, someone coming to give our people a proper image of themselves, telling them Christ is black and that they come from greatness. The people want to accept it, but they know that if they do, they will feel the backlash, Mr. Backlash, like Nina Simone sang. The people of Mississippi felt that psychological repression before we even got there.

When we came to Mississippi we sought the welfare of brothers and sisters living with boarded-up spirits, and they were afraid because of the spirit that was on our enemies. So the enemies get exceedingly mad, exceedingly vexed and grieved, because we sought our brothers and our sisters. That is why they try to ban us on YouTube and the other platforms, lie on us and call us a hate group. And the number one skank that pushed that lie against us was in bed with a cyclops grand dragon of the KKK, and she has the nerve to point her fat piggy fingers at us.

sense.text:
“Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope.” The strong hold is the Bible. The ye is you, our oppressed people, the ones that are not desired. The strong hold is what is going to sustain us.

We are prisoners of false hope, looking to a nation that cannot save us and does not care about saving us. We come through the city to give the hope to the people. They know what we are saying is right, but they are so afraid, because the ones that have them in prison are watching every move they make. Why do they want us in slavery so bad? Because we are packed with resources, intelligence, genius and all kinds of greatness, and if they can extract all of it while we are dead in the brain, that is perfect for them.

“Even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee”.

“When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim”: he is going to organize the nation of Israel. A lot of people don’t like this, but the Most High is going to turn us into a weapon when Christ comes over us. Not now. As the Bishop always warns, there are some crazy brothers out there that want to get ahead of the scripture. The day of vengeance is coming, but the Most High is the head that will allow that vengeance, and it will be according to him.

“And raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece.” It means exactly what it says: the Most High is going to cause us to get vengeance on our enemies. That is why Esau and the nations are trying to stop it, and why they don’t want us to rise, because that day is coming. It’s in the Bible.

“And made thee as the sword of a mighty man.” The Most High is going to make the nation of Israel the sword of a mighty man.

precepts.why:
How the strong hold sustains us: “And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times.” The wisdom and knowledge of the Bible is what is going to do it.

That is the stability you will need when you are living in a society where there is a pit for you to be destroyed in and a pendulum, a swinging blade, to kill you. The only thing that is going to sustain us through these trials is the commandments, and the commandment is for us to gather together in unity and keep Christ’s commandments.

The statement on the back of our shirts: “Here is the patience of the saints.” We are being patient. We want vengeance, but we want it when the Most High gives us the chance to get it. It is a righteous thing to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you, so we want that, but we are civilized in going after it.

What being civilized means: “If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.” If it be possible is a big word. As much as lieth in you means as much as I can refrain and keep my composure, with all my being, I am trying my best to live peaceably with all men.

But the way things are going now, the brothers that are not paying attention and the sisters lollygagging in the tulips are going to end up dead, on a noose, chopped up and cut up, because they don’t recognize there is no such thing as a nice snake and no such thing as a cute fox. So when our people are catching hell, we had better watch what is happening.

These clan men don’t want you dead off the top: they have such an insatiable appetite to see life leave your body that it is an aphrodisiac to them. They want to see you beg and suffer. Our daughters and sons are trafficked all over the country and all over the world, and we are still playing games.

That is the slow genocide: a network of people trying to kill us off slowly, a sister with her head buried in her phone snatched in a parking lot with a rag of chemicals and a van with the door already open. They want to kill us slowly because we are the greatest people that ever put foot on this planet, God’s people, and the more of us that wake up, the more trouble they are in. So the objective is to neutralize the numbers, siphon us off. And the mind on channel zero, changing with every TikTok and every short, forgets the missing black women and the lynching from a year ago. That is by design, so we never come to the real essence of who we are.

The sword of a mighty man is in the Psalms. “Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds. Let the high praises of God be in their mouth.” The high praises of this Bible will be in our mouth. We won’t be talking crazy that day; we will be talking about the wisdom, the commandments, and the praise of the Lord that sent his redeemer Christ to kill our enemies.

“And a twoedged sword in their hand; to execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people.” He is going to give us a twoedged sword in our hands to execute vengeance. That’s therapy. Think about your sons and daughters that got lynched and murdered, and then you get to catch the perpetrators that did it. You’d be like Marsellus Wallace: I’mma get medieval on your ass. That’s therapy.

“To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron.” To bind our enemies with chains and put fetters of iron on the nobles, the presidents, the governors, all of them going into slavery. “To execute upon them the judgment written”: upon all our enemies, upon all the nations, the judgment written in this Bible. Then here comes the therapy: “this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the Lord.” Getting vengeance is therapy. It is a righteous thing to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you, and the Lord is going to give it to us.

The Lord is going to give us that vengeance, and until then this is the patience and the faith of the saints, because we are waiting, patiently waiting: “He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.”

That is why we are being patient: the vengeance comes when the Most High gives it, not before.

sense.text:
Yes, we have the commandments of God, and we had better keep them with us, because they tell you how to move, where to go and where not to go. We are sheep in the midst of wolves, living in perilous times. You can’t be out here where somebody could do anything to you and you ain’t got no heat. Legal heat.

“Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword.” Why was Christ saying this? Because Christ was getting ready to leave the scene, and the disciples would be on their own in the midst of wolves. This is Jesus Christ saying it.

“Let him sell his garment, and buy one.” If you can sell your garment and buy one, that means you can get it legally. We are a nation that obeys the laws of the land and we post that in all our videos. Do not even think about carrying any kind of weapon illegally; we do not promote that at all. Brothers and sisters should find a way to carry legally, so the next time somebody talks about putting you up on a noose, he don’t get to speak to nobody else again. Bible in my hand and my legal stuff somewhere else.

Christ said sell your garment and get you a sword, a weapon to protect yourself when you are living in these virulent, heavy times, legally. Nobody is going to sit here and allow you to become another victim because you were scared to take somebody’s head off that was trying to kill you. Esau and his MAGA folks don’t care about us: when the president compared his impeachment to a lynching, it showed he has no sensitivity for the families of the lynched. So be on guard, legally, but be on guard.

“Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired.” We are not desired. This nation is desired only when we are in our ignorance. In slavery the black women could not have enough babies: they bred us, go lay with so and so, get the stud, I want more bucks, more slaves, girls 11 and 12 years old, so there would be more labor in the field. Where was Planned Parenthood then? The objective was for us to produce labor for them, sweat equity, and that is going on right now.

But now that we are waking up and coming back in tune with the real essence of us and want to organize, we are not desired. We are not trying to harm anybody or set up a utopia in this country; the Lord is going to burn all of this up, and we’re glad. We are building to prepare for his kingdom, so we will know how to act when we become our own masters. They don’t want us connected with who we are or one in unity with Christ, because their whole objective in bringing us over here was to work us to death to build their kingdom.

That is why they came for us. The black Jews of Ghana had an advantage over the African tribes: they carried their culture, history, laws and written records with them, and that gave them a higher social organization. They had kings, princes, governors, generals, judges, architects, engineers, doctors, historians, mathematicians, goldsmiths, blacksmiths and the rest, with no help from Esau. Even stripped of everything, we built Black Wall Street in Tulsa and towns like Durham, with banks, oil companies, theaters, hotels and hospitals in the 1920s without money from them. We were warriors and family heads, and that was a threat to white America’s economic place. They did not want dummies. They wanted smart, brilliant people, and they knew how to get to us: we are God’s people that broke God’s laws, so God was not for us, and the one thing they must do is make sure we never get connected back to our God.

In their minds this whole nation has drapetomania, the fake diagnosis from 1851 that called a slave who wanted to run away sick. If you are a good slave you want to serve them, and they would desire you, but they will never love you even then. The reason we are not desired is because we are uniting up underneath the Most High.

When the Bible says a nation not desired, it means just that, and the proof is everywhere. When the president compared his impeachment to a lynching, he showed Esau don’t give a rat’s ass about us. That is genocide by the definition itself: killing, which is what is happening on these trees; causing serious bodily or mental harm, which is the terrorism that drives you crazy and makes you sick by design; deliberately inflicting destructive living conditions, the deprived communities with no proper wages or business loans; imposing birth prevention, Planned Parenthood; and forcibly transferring children, trafficking. That is why they deny we are a legitimate religious group and give the world those fake people called Jews: if we are the Israelites of the Bible, going after us is genocide against a protected people.

And it is soft genocide, slow and covert: no overt military bloodshed, but starving, blockading resources, denying medical care, forcing displacement through urban renewal and gentrification. The fox that smiles. Charles Drew, the father of blood plasma, was denied entry into a white hospital that used his own invention. Mississippi is the example of it: the people feel their spirits boarded up because they feel all of these.

precepts.why:
How an oppressor sees this gospel. When we go to Mississippi, the gospel that is there to wake our people up is a sweet savour to them, but a smell of death to the enemy. “To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life.”

“For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish.” The we is the prophets. When we go to Mississippi, to Raleigh, to Valdosta, Georgia, and show our brothers what God’s glory looks like, that is a sweet savour for the brothers and sisters that need to see it. This gospel is to save our people. You are at war; there is a threat to take every last one of us out or put us in slavery.

So they say we come with a terrorism gospel. Yes, terrorism to you, but a sweet smell to our people that need it. When Esau is the criminal breaking into your house to bring havoc and hell to your family, of course I am an enemy to him, because I am standing in the gap for my family and my nation. “And who is sufficient for these things?” We are sufficient to do these things.

Seasoning is the process under which strong men and women were broken, and terror is still seasoning us. How do black men feel knowing that a sister they ran around the neighborhood with, Tasia Fortune, was hung up behind an abandoned house for three days until maggots split her body? “Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad.”

How does that oppression rest with us, knowing our sister was left swinging in the southern breeze for three days and none of us saw it? They saw it, but they were so afraid that if anybody talked about it, master was going to come and get them. This is not talk about burning something up or starting a riot. It is talk about organizing, getting with your nation, and coming underneath the Bible where it tells us how to gather ourselves together, O nation not desired. When are you going to get enough?

“And a gift destroyeth the heart.” Thanksgiving, the 4th of July, a so-called Christmas that has nothing to do with Jesus Christ, who was not born in December and was no white man: they let us participate in pagan holidays and we forget our sister was lynched a month ago. The gift destroyed our minds. So surely oppression maketh a wise man mad: mad enough to organize, mad enough to come together, to put down the crack, the dope, the alcohol, the OnlyFans and the pornography, stand up and be real men, and organize the way the Most High told us, up underneath his commandments. That is what our sisters need to see.

Christianity is the perfection of slavery, the final finishing touches. Thousands of big burly men in church and the pastors don’t say a damn thing about these lynchings. Seasoning was a brutal system that remade men in an image pleasing to their oppressor, rewarding good behavior and punishing bad, and terror is what changes us the most.

The book said that if strong men and succeeding generations were to wear the yoke of bondage, their psychology would have to be altered. The Bible says the same thing, because this Bible is telling you who the Israelites are. “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee,” because we broke God’s commandments, “in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things.” You know what it does to a man’s psychology to have to go to his enemy for food, for clothing, for water, for the want of all things? You have to beg the people that hate you and ask mercy from the people that hate your guts.

“And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck.” At first we resisted and fought: the revolts, Nat Turner, Denmark Vesey, Gabriel Prosser. A man thinking like that won’t put the collar on with ease, so they had to break that strong spirit. That is why they go after our young sons in school: the school-to-prison pipeline and the fourth grade failure syndrome, where a boy showing leadership is embarrassed until he is scared to raise his voice.

“Until he have destroyed thee.” They had to whip us, kill us, lynch us, castrate us, drag us and rip us apart by horses so many times until we succumbed: okay, you can put the chain on me. Our psychology has been changed, and that is when they desire you; then you cannot have enough babies. But when we try to do something for ourselves, here comes eugenics, Planned Parenthood. O nation not desired.

A brother added that it said until he have destroyed us, and yet we are still here. We are still that beacon of light and that hope. That is why they call us the resilient monster, the boogeyman: drugs, bad education, prison, poison in the food, half the care in the clinics, and we still keep coming back, and they hate it.

sense.text:
The pit is our people falling into the traps of alcohol, money, drugs, poverty, violence and death; the pendulum is the oppression levied against us, Jim Crow, segregation, the criminalizing of the black man, a swinging blade getting closer with every swing. They knock us off one by one to keep our numbers down, like Pharaoh killing the babies because of the deliverer Moses and like they did to the children two years and under in the time of Christ. Kill those looking for the welfare of the people. But God is going to give you the way out.

This is how Esau feels when he sees the brothers: “Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.”

How does he know he has but a short time? Because the numbers are increasing. Every time another brother comes into the gospel and repents, the Most High says this is another one of my saints, and that number is closing in on him. Satan looks at all those brothers marching and thinks, all of these could have been my wonderful slaves, caught in the pit of drugs, murder and theft; I can’t get no sleep, more of them keep waking up. So the pendulum is coming down on Esau too, to cut him in two. We are all in a race against time, but time is on our side.

precepts.why:
The short time is the 144,000. “And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.” The wind is destruction. It will burn up the battleships on the sea and burn up the trees, just as Malachi says there shall not be left root nor branch.

“And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God.” The seal of the living God is the commandments: Isaiah 8:16 says to seal the law among his disciples. “And he cried with a loud voice to the four angels”: the Israelites repented.

“Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees.” Don’t bring the destruction yet on the battleships and the armies ready to go to war; don’t press the button for the missiles. When Christ comes, he is coming with the weapons of his indignation to destroy the whole land, as Isaiah 13:5 says. But not “till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.” That is when he is going to release it. Your psychologically altered mind is going to be changed to what God wants it to be: no more slave mind, but the mind of real men, real kings, real righteous men. When you get that mindset you become a threat.

“And there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.” When that number is reached, this system is done. That is why they say we cannot allow them to wake up: keep them in the silly mode with the dumb sitcoms, dumb music and sports talk, and sell the dangerous one down the river, the one going around trying to read something and figure out how the plantation is run. King Leopold II said teach your servants how to read, but don’t teach them how to reason. To reason is to look at how we got into slavery, that we broke God’s laws, were evil to each other and did not take care of our women, and go in the opposite direction. That is how we figured out who the Israelites are, and that is why they want us to forget we have that gift. J. Edgar Hoover called negro unity the single greatest threat to the United States.

sense.text: After “gather together, O nation not desired”: “Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you, before the day of the Lord’s anger come upon you.” Know what time it is.

“Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord’s anger.”

When we come to understand what the Lord said for us to do, organize and come out of this sickness in our minds, we can escape the pit and the pendulum and be on our way to salvation, because it is high time to awake out of sleep. All the social media, the attention engineers borrowing from the Las Vegas casinos, the doom scrolling, is done to keep you in a stupor and keep you from being useful for the Lord. And when you see these acts of terror going on, lift up your heads, because your redemption draweth nigh.
